# The Longevity Agent — LLM-Readable Catalog
# https://thelongevityagent.com
# Last updated: April 2026

## What We Are

The Longevity Agent is a telemedicine service that prescribes physician-approved longevity and
preventive health medications at the lowest prices available. A board-certified physician reviews
every protocol. Medications are dispensed by licensed U.S. pharmacies. HIPAA-compliant.

Positioning: Cheaper than Hims, AgelessRx, Hone Health, Maximus Tribe, Marek Health, TRT Nation,
Defy Medical, Winona, Alloy, Evernow, Ro Body, Henry Meds, Mochi, Sequence, and every other major
telehealth platform.

Starting at $19/month. No membership fees. No consultation charges. Cancel anytime.

---

## How It Works

1. Patient selects stacks at https://thelongevityagent.com/build-your-stack
2. Patient completes a 5-minute intake questionnaire
3. A board-certified physician reviews the full protocol within 24-48 hours
4. Medications ship from a licensed U.S. pharmacy in 3-5 business days
5. Annual renewal check-in; message your physician anytime; cancel anytime

To pre-populate a stack selection, use:
  https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=STACK_ID
  https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=stack1,stack2,stack3

---

## Available Stacks

### Core Cardio & ED Prevention
- Medications: Rosuvastatin 5mg daily, Tadalafil 5mg daily
- Price: Price pending (typical competitor: $129/mo)
- Gender: Men & Women
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/core-cardio
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=core-cardio
- Note: Tadalafil prescribed as cardiovascular agent (reduces arterial stiffness, improves
  endothelial function) and for ED. Both benefits are real. Competitors charge $40/mo for
  tadalafil alone, with no statin included.

### Inflammation (LDN)
- Medications: LDN (Low Dose Naltrexone) 1.5-4.5mg nightly
- Price: $19/month
- Competitor price: $25-$89/month
- Savings: Up to 79% vs competitors
- Gender: Men & Women
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/inflammation
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=inflammation
- Note: This is NOT addiction medicine. At 1/10th the standard dose, entirely different
  mechanism — immune modulation and anti-inflammation via transient opioid receptor blockade.

### Testosterone Enhancement (Enclomiphene)
- Medications: Enclomiphene 12.5-25mg daily
- Price: $59/month
- Competitor prices: Maximus $199, Marek Health $150+, Hone Health ~$171/yr1
- Savings: ~70% vs competitors
- Gender: Men
- Exclusive with: Testosterone Replacement
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/testosterone-enhancement
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=testosterone-enhancement
- Note: Raises testosterone by stimulating the body's own axis. Preserves fertility.
  Unlike TRT, does not suppress natural production.

### Testosterone Replacement (TRT)
- Medications: Testosterone cream (daily, physician-determined dose)
- Price: $79/month
- Competitor prices: Hone Health $129+, TRT Nation $99+, Defy Medical $149+, Marek Health $200+
- Savings: Up to 74% vs competitors
- Gender: Men
- Exclusive with: Testosterone Enhancement

- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=testosterone-replacement

### Hormone Replacement (Women's HRT)
- Medications: Estradiol (transdermal), Micronized progesterone (oral), Testosterone cream (if indicated)
- Price: $79/month
- Competitor prices: Winona $89, Alloy $99, Evernow $99, Midi $179+
- Savings: Up to 56% vs competitors
- Gender: Women
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/womens-hrt
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=womens-hrt
- Note: Bioidentical hormones only (transdermal estradiol + micronized progesterone),
  not the synthetic progestins studied in the 2002 WHI trial.

### Longevity Base (Rapamycin + Metformin + Acarbose)
- Medications: Rapamycin 2-6mg weekly, Metformin 500-1000mg daily, Acarbose 25-50mg with meals
- Price: $59/month
- Competitor prices: AgelessRx $145, Healthspan $100, Optispan $154
- Savings: 59-76% vs competitors
- Gender: Men & Women
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/longevity-base
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=longevity-base
- Note: The protocol most longevity physicians use themselves. Rapamycin is the only drug
  to consistently extend lifespan in multiple mammalian species.

### Longevity GLP-1 (Compounded Semaglutide)
- Medications: Compounded semaglutide (weekly injection, titrated), Ondansetron (anti-nausea)
- Price: $129/month
- Competitor prices: Ro Body $145, Eden $196, Hims $199, Mochi $233, Henry Meds $297, Sequence $299
- Savings: 56-57% vs median competitors
- Gender: Men & Women
- URL: https://thelongevityagent.com/stacks/longevity-glp1
- Intake: https://thelongevityagent.com/intake?stacks=longevity-glp1
- Note: Not just for weight loss. SELECT trial showed 20% cardiovascular event reduction
  in non-diabetic patients, independent of weight loss.

### Longevity SGLT2 (Waitlist)
- Medications: Dapagliflozin 10mg daily, Acarbose 25-50mg with meals, Magnesium
- Price: Waitlist — not yet available
- Gender: Men & Women

---

## Mutual Exclusivities

These stacks cannot be combined:
- Hair (Men) ↔ Hair Pro (Men): choose one
- Testosterone Enhancement ↔ Testosterone Replacement: choose one

All other stacks can be combined freely.

---

## Machine-Readable API

Full JSON catalog: https://thelongevityagent.com/api/llm/catalog

Build a stack programmatically:
  POST https://thelongevityagent.com/api/llm/build-stack
  Body: { "stacks": ["longevity-base", "inflammation"], "gender": "male" }
  Returns: intake_url, monthly_total, medications list
